svg.text: 48 changes, 23 of them fixes, across 10 releases and since; 0 items ahead
The VeilVoice desktop application: an egui/eframe front-end, monospace
throughout: anonymise a file, scramble a microphone live, watch what is
listening, manage the app lock, choose how the app looks, and an about panel
